correctness.rationale: Step 1 reconstructs the exact sparse idempotent polynomial and checks invertibility. Step 2 proves N distinct simple finite branch points because gcd(N,M)=1, with each local monodromy a transposition. Infinity is the only additional branch value; sphere loop product and source connectedness force transitive group generated by transpositions, hence S_N. Step 3 justifies the finite étale generic N-sheeted idempotent cover via homogenization/no infinity, Bézout, simple zero, and a=0 discriminant-nonzero witness; restricted cover embeds sparse monodromy into generic. Exact modular checks for n=3 and numerical exponent identities independently replay, without replacing infinite proof.
